b_only.addressee: Aircraft operators flying between aerodromes in the same outermost region or Member State
b_only.benefit_or_duty: Flights within the same outermost region/Member State are deemed compliant with surrender, MRV and registry rules, sparing operators the compliance burden

b_only.addressee: Shipping companies operating containerships of 10,000 TEU and above
b_only.benefit_or_duty: Large containerships (10,000 TEU+) on long transhipment voyages may surrender fewer allowances than their verified emissions, cutting their compliance cost

b_only.addressee: Aircraft operators subject to CORSIA offsetting
b_only.benefit_or_duty: Aircraft operators must cancel their notified quantity of CORSIA-eligible units by fixed statutory deadlines for each CORSIA compliance period

b_only.addressee: Aircraft operators using eligible aviation fuels/electricity on EEA-departing flights
b_only.benefit_or_duty: A further 110 million allowances are reserved to fund eligible aviation fuel/electricity use, extended to all flights departing the EEA from 2029

b_only.addressee: Commission/Member States administering the Market Stability Reserve
b_only.benefit_or_duty: The Market Stability Reserve release thresholds (400 million / 300 million allowances, 100 million release amount) that return allowances to auction also tighten by 4% each year from 2029, restricting the supply released back to the market
